title: Window Flags & Canonical Spine Finalization
summary: T0: branch/prompt/config committed (phase-4-approved tag created and master fast-forwarded in the same session, since it did not yet exist). T1: pre-mutation guard reproduced Phase 4's T1 exactly (20,951/287/386/259-28-127, all reconciled) and exported view_ddl_pre.sql; also surfaced a file2 preview via the live view's existing coverage_class columns (~100%/99.98% not-full-window) that foreshadowed T4's escalation. T2: full-table trades-side bitmap over all 20,951 in-scope events (one budgeted pass over filtered_trades, 4.95B rows) - file1 not-full-window=287 exact, file2=5,188/5,188. T3: quotes-side bitmap reused Phase 4's cached full-population actual-sessions parquet (calendar pin/offsets/population all verified matching) instead of a second full-table pass - file1=386 exact, file2=5,187/5,188. T4: derived spine_window_flags (20,951 rows), carried Phase 3/4 labels, ran all reconciliation checks - T4a/b/c exact/clean, T4d triggered escalation row 4 (file2 flagged share ~100%/99.98%, ~20x over the >5%/>260 threshold). HARD STOP per the phase prompt's own instruction; committed and reported to Cooper. Amendment 4 (Cooper, in-session): accepted file2's flagged share as structural (matches Phase 2 T8's pre-existing coverage_class.parquet, computed via the identical derivation, plus the already-logged 2025 3-column-schema issue) - retroactively rescoped row 4 to file1 only (observed 1.82%/2.45%, passing), no re-derivation. T5 (resumed): rebuilt momentum_events_canonical additively (stage="t7" in src/data/canonical.py) - row count/in_scope unchanged, 3,103-row/400-ticker sample byte-identical on pre-existing columns, idempotent on a second rebuild. Did not duplicate quotes_full_window (verified byte-identical to the pre-existing Phase 2 T8 column across all 20,951 events before writing the SQL). T6: 3 charts per contract, kaleido-verified before commit (fixed a footnote-overflow issue and an annotation-placement bug along the way). T7: register updated (37-event item closed, window-flags disposition closed, file2-share-structural item closed, no-signature-events item closed with precise counts, not the prompt's approximate figure), this digest, REPORT.md.

surprises: The live view already carried the exact answer to T4's central question before T2/T3 ran: Phase 2 T8's coverage_class.parquet (computed with an identical full-table-pass derivation) showed file2 at ~100%/99.98% not-full-window.
